The '''Barium Frizz''' was a [[Foodstuff/Legends|beverage]] created by the [[Human/Legends|human]] [[Bartender/Legends|bartender]] [[Wuher/Legends|Wuher]] of [[Chalmun's Spaceport Cantina/Legends|Chalmun's Spaceport Cantina]], located in the [[Mos Eisley/Legends|Mos Eisley]] settlement on<ref name="FF67" /> the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]] [[Planet/Legends|planet]]<ref name="TEA">''[[The Essential Atlas]]''</ref> [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]]. The drink was one of Wuher's most popular inventions,<ref name="FF67" /> and it shared its name with [[barium liquid]], a [[Foodstuff/Legends|product]] served at [[Dex's Diner/Legends|Dex's Diner]] on<ref name="Dex">{{Hyperspace|url=fans/hyperspace/source/dexdiner/index.html|text=Dining at Dex's|int=Dining at Dex's}}</ref> the [[Core Worlds/Legends|Core Worlds]]<ref name="TEA" /> planet [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]]<ref name="Dex" /> at some point no earlier than [[28 BBY/Legends|28 BBY]].<ref name="DexDates">{{Hyperspace|url=fans/hyperspace/source/dexdiner/index.html|text=Dining at Dex's|int=Dining at Dex's}} is set at some point no earlier than [[28 BBY/Legends|28 BBY]] per the {{DiningAtDexDate}}.</ref> In [[0 BBY/Legends|0 BBY]],<ref name="0 BBY">''[[The Essential Reader's Companion]]'' dates the events of "[[Be Still My Heart: The Bartender's Tale]]" to [[0 BBY/Legends|0 BBY]].</ref> during his bartending shift at the [[Cantina/Legends|cantina]], Wuher automatically made beverages such as Barium Frizzes while his [[Brain/Legends|mind]] was occupied with the contemplation of his encounters with the [[Droid/Legends|droid]] [[C2-R4]] as well as the [[Pheromone/Legends|pheromone]]-charged smell of the [[Rodian/Legends|Rodian]] [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunter]] [[Greedo/Legends|Greedo]] earlier that same [[Local day/Legends|day]].<ref name="Tales" />

==Behind the scenes==
[[File:BariumRealWorld.jpg|thumb|right|250px|A sample of pure real-world barium]]
The Barium Frizz was introduced in "[[Be Still My Heart: The Bartender's Tale]]," a short story written by [[David Bischoff]] and published in the [[1995]] anthology ''[[Tales from the Mos Eisley Cantina]]''.<ref name="Tales" /> The capitalized spelling of the drink's name subsequently came with the [[The Official Star Wars Fact File 67|sixty-seventh issue]] of [[De Agostini]]'s ''[[The Official Star Wars Fact File]]'' magazine,<ref name="FF67" /> which was released around [[April 9]], [[2003]]<ref name="Date">{{FFdates|67}}</ref> and written by [[Iain Lowson]].<ref name="FF Author">{{LinkedIn|url=in/iainlowson|text=Iain Lowson|archivefile=File:IainLowson-LinkedIn.png}}</ref> In the real-world, [[Wikipedia:Barium|barium]] is a [[Wikipedia:Chemical element|chemical element]] and [[Wikipedia:Metal|metal]] that, in nature, is always found in the form of [[Wikipedia:Chemical compound|chemical compounds]]. All [[Wikipedia:Solubility|soluble]] barium compounds are toxic to [[Wikipedia:Mammal|mammals]], whereas the insoluble [[Wikipedia:Barium sulfate|barium sulfate]] is used as a [[Wikipedia:Radiocontrast agent|radiocontrast agent]] in [[Wikipedia:Upper gastrointestinal series|X-ray imaging]] of the human [[Wikipedia:Gastrointestinal tract|gastrointestinal tract]].<ref name="BariumBritannica">{{WebCite|url=https://www.britannica.com/science/barium|text=Barium &#124; Uses, Compounds, & Facts|author=The Editors of Encyclopædia Britannica|date=2024-06-14|work=[[Wikipedia:Encyclopædia Britannica|''Encyclopædia Britannica'']]|archivedate=20240226155412}}</ref>
